name: Mento Japanese Yen
oneLiner: JPYm is Mento's CDP-backed yen stablecoin, minted against USDm collateral via the Mento FX system on Celo with on-chain reserve and oracle pricing.
collateral: Mento CDP debt backed by USDm collateral, with live collateral and debt rows exposed by the Mento reserve dashboard API
pegMechanism: CDP-backed Mento FX stablecoin: borrowers mint JPYm against USDm collateral, while repayment/redemption mechanics and oracle pricing route value back through the Mento system

mintAuthority.summary: JPYm is minted CDP-style via immutable BorrowerOperations on Celo; token owner on both Celo and Monad is the same 4/6 Mento Safe (Celo) / 4/7 Safe (Monad) at 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 with no modules or guard.

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations (immutable CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: JPYm mints only against USDm CDP collateral; BorrowerOperations has no owner() and no EIP-1967 proxy slot — immutable.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, BorrowerOperations 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A: 46358-byte code, owner() empty, EIP-1967 impl and admin slots zero — immutable, no upgrade path.

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577 and Monad block 80607801: JPYm owner on both chains = Safe 0x58099B...; Celo Safe now 4/6 (one signer rotated out since prior review); Monad Safe 4/7; BorrowerOperations confirmed immutable on Celo. Monad proxy admin owned by same Safe. All addressable mint surfaces confirmed on both chains. Economic-control fields authored 2026-07-20: economicCapSemantics is unbounded because, unlike Mento V2 assets whose mint path sits behind the 48-hour Mento Timelock, the JPYm token owner is a plain 4-of-6 Safe on Celo and 4-of-7 Safe on Monad at 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 with no modules, no guard, and no delay, so it can authorize a different minter and issue without an independently enforced bound. reconciliation is continuous because JPYm is a Mento V3 CDP whose USDm collateral is held and observable on-chain rather than in an off-chain reserve requiring periodic attestation. supervision is none: Mento operates no named prudential regulator relationship for JPYm. Upgradeability authored 2026-07-21: Celo block 72722488 confirmed the standard EIP-1967 admin and implementation storage slots are both zero (Mento StableTokenV3 uses a custom, non-EIP-1967 proxy pattern) while owner() independently resolved to the same 4-of-6 Mento Safe recorded above; the implementation address is the shared StableTokenV3 logic contract also used by the sibling CHFm deployment.

reserveReview.rationale: JPYm's live reserve exposure is USDm (Mento Dollar), linked to tracked cUSD-celo. Mento documentation describes USDm as reserve-backed, and the live reserve row is a single 100% USDm CDP collateral exposure; no additional dependency slice is inferred.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mento USDm stable-token documentation and current reserve dashboard
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The USDm dependency identity is known, but the underlying Mento Reserve basket is an upstream asset's reserve composition and is not duplicated as JPYm collateral.
